role: Single source of truth for every measurable visual threshold in this plugin. Prose in skills/, openai-skills/, and README.md must agree with the numbers here; tests/test_visual_contract.py enforces that agreement in both directions.

severity_meaning.blocking: Mechanically unambiguous. A measuring script exits non-zero and the render report records FAIL.
severity_meaning.advisory: Measured and always reported, but the metric over-reports or needs compositional judgment, so it informs the critic instead of hard-failing the script.

type.feed_width_px.rationale: Approximate width LinkedIn renders the image at in feed. The downscale is the honest legibility test.

type.feed_floor_px.rationale: Below 22px in the artboard is texture at feed scale. Acceptable for micro labels and card body copy, not for load-bearing text. A script cannot always tell which is which, so every sub-floor node is reported and the critic judges load-bearing status.

type.absolute_floor_px.rationale: The type scale's smallest sanctioned role is the 10-11px micro label. Rendered text below 10px is broken at any reading distance, with no judgment needed.

type.min_headline_px.rationale: The sanctioned headline role is 56-72px. If the largest text on the artboard is under 40px there is no type hierarchy at all, which is a structural failure rather than a taste question.

occupancy.min_pct.rationale: The primary composition should use roughly 82-92% of the usable vertical canvas. Intentional sparse concepts may go lower when the negative space has a clear compositional job, so this is reported rather than hard-failed.

occupancy.max_pct.rationale: Above roughly 92% the composition is crowding its own margins. Density earned through editing can exceed it, so this informs the critic.

footer.max_gap_px.rationale: An unexplained vertical gap greater than 120px between the end of the primary composition and the footer leaves the footer detached from the page. Blocking, with a documented-exception path for deliberate negative space.

containment.max_border_depth.rationale: Maximum bordered containment depth is two levels. A bordered card inside a bordered card inside a bordered panel is unambiguous and mechanically countable.

safe_margin_px.rationale: The title block and footer are where the reader's eye returns. Motion inside the outer 48px makes the whole image feel unstable. Animated elements are enumerable, so this blocks.

contrast.text_min_ratio.rationale: WCAG AA body floor, already enforced on catalog tokens by scripts/info_stories.py::validate_catalog. The audit extends the same function to colours as actually rendered.

contrast.state_min_ratio.rationale: Non-text state and boundary floor, enforced on catalog state_pairs.

motion.max_patterns.rationale: Two motion primitives is the norm for a single-focus layout; check_composition already enforces it on the story contract.

motion.max_moving_area_pct.rationale: DELIBERATELY ADVISORY. The repo's own measurements refute this as a gate: the Specimen Grid reference moves ~85% of the canvas and still encodes at an eighth of the per-frame cost of an ~11% reference. Bounding-box area over-reports badly for stroke animations and dense grids of small loops. Treat it as a smell test for an accidental full-canvas fade. The real budget is motion.mean_step_max_pct.

motion.mean_step_warn_pct.rationale: Mean share of pixels changing between consecutive frames. Under 2% is healthy on any ground; 2-5% is viable only on a dark flat ground.

motion.mean_step_max_pct.rationale: Above 5% mean per-frame change, something full-bleed is animating. This is the real motion budget, measured in changed pixels rather than area.

loop.seam_ratio_warn.rationale: Seam change divided by the largest change between any two consecutive frames. At or below 1.25 the seam is indistinguishable from any other frame boundary, which is what a clean loop means.

loop.seam_ratio_max.rationale: AUTHORITATIVE loop metric, replacing two conflicting absolute seam percentages that appeared in prose (0.5% in animation-recipes.md and 8% in qa-gates.md described the same measurement with a 16x disagreement). An absolute seam percentage is misleading because the last frame legitimately sits one step of motion before the loop point, and on a stepped animation one step can be a large visual change. The ratio normalises the seam against that step, so it is the number that gates.

fonts.first_choice_available.rationale: ADVISORY BY DESIGN. No font files are bundled and network fonts are banned by scripts/lint_artboard.sh, so the same HTML renders with different typography on macOS, CI Linux and Windows. A fallback face can be a perfectly good serif, so this does not block. What must never happen is the substitution being silent: the audit records the first-choice family and the family that actually resolved, so every type measurement in the report can be read against the typography that really rendered.

gif.max_bytes.rationale: 5 MB. LinkedIn accepts larger but transcodes them, and the transcode is visibly worse than an honest reduction ladder.

gates.artboard-integrity: The artboard element exists and measures exactly the declared canvas.
gates.feed-scale-legibility: Load-bearing text survives the feed-width downscale.
gates.bottom-dead-zone: The composition fills its vertical canvas intentionally.
gates.footer-detachment: The footer belongs to the page rather than floating below a gap.
gates.nested-card-density: Bordered containment stays within two levels.
gates.safe-zone-violation: The outer safe margin stays free of motion.
gates.contrast-floor: Text and state colours meet their contrast ratios as rendered.
gates.motion-discipline: Motion pattern count stays within the story contract limit.
gates.motion-budget: Per-frame changed-pixel cost stays inside the encode budget.
gates.font-determinism: The typography that rendered is recorded, so it can never differ silently between machines.
gates.loop-close: The loop seam is indistinguishable from any other frame boundary.
gates.file-budget: The encoded GIF fits the delivery budget.
